brief:
Israeli opposition leader Avigdor Lieberman called Sunday for the dismantling of the Palestinian Authority and establishment of an Israeli-Jordanian confederation to govern parts of the West Bank, according to Middle East Eye. Lieberman did not elaborate on the proposal's specifics or timeline for implementation.

The statement represents a significant shift in positioning among Israeli opposition figures regarding Palestinian governance structures and regional arrangements.
